transaction.reason: Installed acceptance exposed YAML loading in the bootstrap interpreter. Complete identity is now computed by a fixed module through the already verified isolated engine; bootstrap stays standard-library-only and the project pin remains engine-only.

The installed traversal passes with full Skill identity delegated to the verified runtime. It also proves instruction-only changes alter Skill content without changing engine identity, old namespaces refuse, and explicit project updates work. Repository helpers remain outside the distributed Skill.
